# maz-ui

> These rules and the docs in `node_modules/maz-ui/agent-docs` match the installed maz-ui.

This project is built with **maz-ui** and its ecosystem. Reuse what it provides instead of re-implementing it: UI elements, helpers, icons and styles you need usually already exist.

### Look it up before you write it

- **MCP server `maz-ui`** (when available): `search_docs` (describe the need: "confirm before delete"), `get_component_api`, `find_icons`, `get_theme_tokens`, `get_doc` (icons, helpers, themes, translations, plugins, forms), `review_code`.
- Otherwise the version-matched docs in `node_modules/maz-ui/agent-docs/` and `node_modules/@maz-ui/<package>/agent-docs/` (start with `node_modules/maz-ui/agent-docs/README.md`; in a monorepo, the packages of the app).

Never guess an API: only use documented props, events, slots and imports.

### Rules

- `Maz*` components instead of native elements or hand-made widgets (`MazBtn` not `<button>`, `MazInput`, `MazSelect`, `MazDialog`, `MazCard`...). A button with only an icon needs an `aria-label`.
- Icons from `@maz-ui/icons` (`find_icons`), never inline SVG nor another icon library.
- `@maz-ui/utils` and the maz-ui composables instead of lodash, VueUse or hand-written helpers. `useToast()` for notifications, `useDialog()` for confirmations (they need their plugin).
- Theme (brand colors, dark mode) through a `@maz-ui/themes` preset and `useTheme()`, never by hand.

### Styling with Tailwind

Only use theme tokens (`bg-surface text-foreground border-divider`, `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`, `text-muted`...). `get_theme_tokens` lists the maz-ui tokens and the ones of the project; when a value is missing, add a token to the project `@theme`.

- Never the default Tailwind palette (`bg-blue-500`, `text-gray-600`, `bg-white`, `text-black`) nor hard-coded colors (`#fff`, `rgb()`, `bg-[#...]`). Theme colors already adapt to dark mode: no `dark:` color overrides.
- **No `maz:` prefix**: it is internal to the maz-ui library.
- In custom CSS, use the variables: `var(--maz-primary)`, `var(--maz-rounded-md)`.

### Imports

- Deep imports: `maz-ui/components/MazBtn`, `maz-ui/composables/useToast`, `@maz-ui/utils/helpers/debounce`, `@maz-ui/icons/raw/MazTrash`. The `maz-ui` root entry only exports types. Never import from `maz-ui/src` or `maz-ui/dist`.
- With `@maz-ui/nuxt`, components and composables are auto-imported (icons are not).

### Before you finish

Run `review_code` (MCP) on the files you changed, or `npx @maz-ui/mcp review <files>`, and fix every finding.
